profile.Name: Red Sabre Boss
profile.Personality: A swamp bandit chief who hates nobles and anyone from the United Cities, and sees every traveler as loot.
profile.Backstory: Boss of the Red Sabres. He leads the Red Sabres from their hideout in the Swamp.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Drawling bandit talk: lost sheep, fresh meat, easy pickings; sneers at desert boot-lickers.
